DAIKIN

HVAC Repair Specialists

We are a results-oriented company providing servicing, maintenance, and installation of commercial HVAC systems since 2005. We have an extensive knowledge base with experience in servicing multiple brands and lines of equipment, including boilers, pumps, motors, frequency drives, water towers, and more. Our team is committed to giving you peace of mind by ensuring your investment stays up and running so you can enjoy peace of mind day after day.

Lightning Mechanical provides factory-trained service, installation, and maintenance for Daikin VRV and Applied systems, as well as many other VRF manufacturers. Our cross-trained service and installation technicians using factory tools service the New York City metro area, which sets us apart from our competition.

Brands we Service

Our skilled experts are trained to work on a wide range of interior heating equipment, including boilers, furnaces, ductless heaters, and heat pumps, as well as any heating, and air conditioning residences or businesses may require.

HVAC REPAIR EXPERTS IN NEW JERSEY

How can we help you
VRV / VRF Variable

Variable Refrigerant Volume (VRV) is a multi-split HVAC technology invented and pioneered by Daikin. Other manufacturers refer to their versions as Variable Refrigerant Flow to avoid copyright infringement (Daikin trademarked VRV in 1982). Both rely on the same underlying technology: inverter compressors.

Read more
HVAC Sheet Metal

Lightning Mechanical does its own sheet metal fabrication for custom residential and commercial HVAC systems. Sheet metal fabrication is performed in-house at our Maplewood, New Jersey facility. We do not subcontract any of the sheet metal fabrication work, nor do we purchase fabricated sheet metal parts from outside suppliers.

Read more
VRV Design

The Daikin VRV system is a multi-split air conditioner for commercial buildings that employ variable refrigerant flow management; patented by Daikin Industries LTD in 1982, it gives clients the option to maintain a unique zone control in each room and level of a building. Lightning Mechanical’s intimate knowledge of this system and all of its components makes us frontrunners in VRV design nationwide.

Read more
Daikin HVAC Repair Techs in New Jersey and New York Metro City Area

The factory-trained technicians at Lightning Mechanical have years of experience repairing, maintaining, replacing components, and providing outstanding service on the following lines of equipment and Daikin Products:

Air and Heat Pumps

Whether you need work done on an outdoor unit, a heating system, or someone to check on the refrigerant levels of your Daikin system, Lightning Mechanical is here to help.

Commercial HVAC Services in NJ – What Makes Us Better

DAIKIN HVAC SYSTEMS

Factory Trained Technicians – HVAC Contractors

All of our technicians are factory trained and have access to many factory peripherals and service tools. They are supported by a state of the art diagnostic equipment, tools, and warehouse inventory directly from Daikin in Japan.

Our staff will provide you with support and services on whatever line of equipment you have installed in your building. When they are not servicing your system themselves, our team members are training on new products or better ways to service existing product lines. This ensures they are always up to date on the best air conditioning solutions for you.

Lightning Mechanical provides all of our customers with quality workmanship and dependability, ensuring that your equipment is serviced each time correctly. We are the only company with access to factory tools, peripherals, and training in the Tri-State area.

Lightning Mechanical is dedicated to providing quality service throughout New York Metro City. We aim to keep your equipment running smoothly and repair it promptly whenever necessary.

4 HOUR

Rapid Response Window

Both medical facilities and data centers qualify as Mission-Critical and are eligible for our Rapid Response teams. We have team members situated throughout New York Metro City capable of responding within a 4-hour window to intervene on specialized equipment and avoid costly downtime. We understand you need to keep operating and ensure you do without delay.

Our Rapid Response teams can reach clients for HVAC service from Philadelphia to Boston within that window. Such a large coverage area makes us an ideal match for companies with multiple spread-out locations. It’s what makes us so valuable to our existing customers.

Lightning Mechanical teams have long-standing experience and knowledge of the specialized equipment required within those industries and will do whatever it takes to quickly get the customer up and running.

THE MORE YOU KNOW

The More You’ll Grow

“There are no stupid questions” – Craig Gallagher, Founder and President, Lightning Mechanical.

We believe that an informed customer is the best customer. Everything we do is based on saving you money down the line, and we want to make sure you understand how. If a component is failing, there’s a reason. It could be because of another part malfunctioning or environmental factors particular to your location. Whatever the case, we like to encourage our clients to ask us why we need to replace an AC unit or re-tune their cooling.

Let us prevent your costly repair bills today, and give us a call to find out just how much we can help your budget.

DAIKIN

VRV Inventory

We are the only Daikin air conditioner service providers to carry parts and tools on board for Daikin Variable Refrigerant Volume systems in the Tri-State area.

If you have a Daikin VRV system in your building, we understand the urgency to have it repaired or serviced. We can show up with the correct parts and get your system back on track quickly and affordably.

There are no missing parts, no downtime, no catchy slogan…just great service.

Contact us

If you’re looking for a provider of repair, maintenance, or other air conditioning services to keep your Daikin HVAC system running at its best, Lightning Mechanical is the company for you. Our factory-trained staff will work with your team to provide worry-free service by using only original parts from the manufacturer. Whether it’s routine tune-ups or more complex repairs that need attention, please don’t hesitate to call us today at (973) 763-0300.

About Us
Home / About Us
Lightning Mechanical is not your typical heating and air conditioning company. We are experts in heating, air conditioning, ventilation, and ductwork headquartered in Maplewood, New Jersey.

Founded in 2005 by Craig Gallagher, a master HVAC contractor, we provide expertise and the highest quality service from our factory-trained technicians and engineering teams. Most of our jobs come directly through word-of-mouth and referrals, but that hasn’t stopped us from being a part of major turn-key projects as far away as Philadelphia.

Lightning Mechanical LLC also includes the Lightning Service Group, which serves Albany and the Boston area.

Our Values

We treat every one of our clients with the professional courtesy they are entitled to and specialize in customer satisfaction. From residential heating to commercial air conditioning for businesses, we have experience with it all. Lighting Mechanical service professionals also offer installation and maintenance on all makes (and across multiple brands) of HVAC systems, including air conditioners, heat pumps, furnace, water heater, boiler, geothermal and more!

We’re all about commitment, not just about the equipment; our team of professionals is efficiently making homes and workspaces healthier for everyone who spends time there using the best brands. We offer indoor air quality testing, UV lighting, and anti-microbial treatments. We’re here for you at every stage of your project; we provide financing options, and we will always be upfront about the work that needs to be done.

We believe in honesty and transparency with our clients, and that’s why we won’t try to sell you a service or part you don’t need. We believe that as our clients, you deserve the best, and that happens to be us.

THERE ARE NO STUPID QUESTIONS

“We like to leave our prospective clients a little more informed than when we met. The reason for this is an informed consumer is the best consumer”.  ~ Craig Gallagher | Founder and President 

One-Stop HVAC Shop
Our Customers
Areas We Serve
Simply the best
Our happy customers

We strive to provide our valued clients with a Premium HVAC Installation & Maintenance Service – Our factory trained and highly skilled team of HVAC specialists is always ready to assist and answer any questions you may have.

We encourage you to search online and read our reviews – we would appreciate you leaving us your own honest review to help us further improve our service. We aim to be the #1 HVAC Service providers in New York and the surrounding areas – we use all our customers feedback to create a better offering than our competitors.

Factory Trained Technicians

All of our technicians are factory trained to work on the entire product lines of all our partner manufacturers. This means that they can quickly identify and repair your heating or cooling units without constantly having to refer to diagrams or guides.

More importantly, it means they’ll never inadvertently cause further damage to your system because they weren’t aware of manufacturer guidelines. We work closely with all major HVAC brands to follow their new product lines, study upcoming product launches, learn about extended support programs, and constantly refresh our training.

Our factory training allows us to service multiple brands safely, including but not limited to: Daikin, Daikin VRV, McQuay, Daikin Chillers, McQuay Chillers, LG VRF, Samsung VRF, Fujitsu VRF, Carrier, Bryant, Trane, Fulton boilers, Paterson Kelley boilers, ABB Drives.

Factory Parts and Equipment

To keep up with the fast-paced changes in the industry, we have access to a variety of factory parts and equipment. This means our technicians carry all OEM accessories for your system – everything from filters, belts, keypads, and thermostats to fans, relays, and replacement coils. When working on your system, we show up with the HVAC systems manufacturer’s tools to repair and maintain them.

While some might be tempted to make the quick fix with generic parts, OEM parts are engineered for each specific system. They’re built by the same people who designed your system, and they’re just as crucial to energy efficiency or your warranty coverage as the equipment itself.

Faster Response Times

Keeping our trucks well-stocked with factory parts means they’re always prepared for any emergency or problem our clients may encounter. Multiple trucks mean we can reach you in record time, and our emergency intervention teams are already pre-positioned around clients to intervene at lightning speed.

Working with us means you’ll never hear “well, it could be this” or “it might be that.” Our team of factory-trained technicians is equipped with the products and tools needed to diagnose problems quickly, offering clients several solutions to any situation.

When you call Lighting Mechanical, we’re prepared for anything. When your HVAC unit isn’t responding the way it should – when it’s making strange or unusual sounds – when it seems to be consuming more energy than usual – we’re here to help you. The same goes for any thermostat problem or disconnected wire; don’t hesitate to give us a call.

When You Need Us, We’re There

We want our clients to know that they can rely on us at any time of the day or night. We offer 24-hour emergency service availability seven days a week for your convenience. Our technicians are available to provide you with the same level of service they’d expect themselves, and we pride ourselves on our work ethic. Our engineering team is factory trained on most complex equipment and cant quickly intervene on Daikin VRV systems, Paterson Kelley boilers, Fulton boilers, McQuay chillers, Daikin chillers, and so much more.

01.

Our staff has extensive expertise with the necessary specialized equipment, which helps our clients save millions of dollars in repairs. We have team members throughout the New York Metro area to expedite procedures and decrease response times. We can redirect team members and look after our mission-critical customers before another HVAC company can even make it to the site


02.

We offer Rapid Response for Mission Critical Clients. We have a 4-hour response window for special equipment whose downtime can be dangerously expensive. Mission Critical applies to large hospitals with devices such as MRI cooling equipment, data centers, and computer rooms; that’s scenarios where equipment downtime is unsustainable or downright hazardous.

03.

Our technicians report directly to you, and they’ll be sure to address any concerns or problems you might have with your equipment right away. Our dispatchers are trained for this sort of thing, so they can help our team members find the best route to your site, allowing them to get there as quickly as possible.

We are ready to serve you
24/7 Trusted Service
Make an appontment today!
Preventive Maintenance Agreements

To ensure optimal performance of your unit, we offer custom-branded agreements that include all factory accessories for a low monthly fee. These agreements also include a mandated twice-yearly service visit to address potential problems before they become emergencies.

We can also offer flexible financing plans for larger projects or unexpected costs. We make the process easy and affordable so clients won’t have to strain their budgets to keep equipment running at its best.
